title: 2 Beds 1 Bath - Apartment
description:
Welcome to 1527 W Westmoreland St, a completely gut-renovated property in Philadelphia offering modern apartments with high-end finishes and fully updated systems throughout. Located just minutes from Temple University Hospital and Temple Medical School, this property provides convenient access to major employment centers, public transportation, and neighborhood amenities.
This apartment has 2 bedrooms, a bright and functional layout, and private storage space in the basement, providing additional room for belongings rarely found in typical apartment living.
The kitchens showcase quartz countertops, designer cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and dishwashers, creating a sleek and modern space perfect for everyday living.
Everything in the building is brand new, including:
• New roof
• Intercom system
• All new electrical system
• All new plumbing
• Energy-efficient mini-split heating and cooling systems for year-round comfort
• Designer kitchens with quartz countertops
• Custom cabinetry and modern finishes throughout
• Fully renovated interiors and building systems
• Storage space in basement
Situated on a residential block very close to Temple University Hospital and the Temple Medical campus, the property offers convenient access to public transportation, major roadways, local shops, and neighborhood services.
Rental Requirements:
- Gross monthly income of at least 2.5x the monthly rent
- No smoking and no dogs permitted cats are welcome
- Ideally, applicants should have at least 6 months of employment with their current employer
- No minimum credit score required.

title: 2 Beds 2 Baths Apartment
description:
A rare top-floor 2 bedroom, 2 full bath home in Millvale where each bedroom has its own private bathroom. Great for two roommates splitting the cost (about $1,125 each) or a couple who wants extra privacy. Comes fully furnished by a former Airbnb host.
Rent covers everything: electric, gas, water, trash, gigabit Wi-Fi, and a professional deep clean every 60 days. Move in with beds already made, kitchen stocked, and Wi-Fi already running — nothing to set up.
Inside: an open living area with an exposed brick wall, a quartz kitchen island with breakfast bar seating, a private attic suite with its own bathroom, a small office nook, in-unit washer/dryer, and a smart TV.
Commute: roughly 10-15 minutes to UPMC Presbyterian, Shadyside, Children's, and Mercy; about 10 minutes to Allegheny General; 12 minutes to St. Margaret; and easy access to Pitt, CMU, and Duquesne. Free street parking, no garage or permit fees.
Just a 3-minute walk to Millvale's main street — brewery, coffee shops, a beloved French bakery, and the riverfront trail. Quiet street, and bedrooms stay dark for night-shift sleepers.
International tenants welcome, no US credit history required (an appointment letter or institutional reference works fine). Same-day video tours, and sight-unseen leasing is welcome. Flexible lease terms available
